row: FOX40 News in Sacramento is committed to “News That Matters,” sharing stories and creating content that informs and empowers people throughout the Sacramento-Stockton-Modesto region. You can always expect the latest local news, sports and weather coverage across multiple platforms. Sign up for the FOX40 newsletter to get “News That Matters” directly to your inbox. Download the FOX40 mobile app to stay up-to-date anywhere, anytime.
